title: Update a TTO Creator Marketplace campaign
content_data:
Use this endpoint to update a TikTok One (TTO) Creator Marketplace campaign. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tto/tcm/campaign/update/ **Method** POST **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Type{10%}|Description{60%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Access token authorized by a TTO Creator Marketplace account.
For details, see [Authentication](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/obtain-authorization-and-authentication-from-a-tto-creator-marketplace-account/v1.3).| |Content-Type {Required}|string|Request message type.
Allowed format: `application/json`. | ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{10%}|Description{60%}| |--- |--- |--- | | tto_tcm_account_id {Required} | string | The ID of the TTO Creator Marketplace account.

To obtain the IDs of the accounts that you can access via `Access-Token`, use [/tto/oauth2/tcm/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1815693478150146). | | campaign_id{Required} | string | The ID of an existing TTO Creator Marketplace campaign.

To retrieve existing campaigns with your TTO Creator Marketplace account, use [/tto/tcm/campaign/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1815693562720258). | | campaign_type{Required} | string | The type of the TTO Creator Marketplace campaign.

Enum value:
  • `CAMPAIGN`: A campaign with a [campaign-level invite link](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1830337139853313#item-link-Campaign-level%20invite%20link).
  • `BRAND_LINK`: A campaign with a [brand-level invite link](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1830337139853313#item-link-Brand-level%20invite%20link).
| | handle_names | string[] |
  • Valid only when a campaign with a campaign-level invite link is specified through `campaign_id`.
  • Not supported when a campaign with a brand-level invite link is specified through `campaign_id`.

The handle name list of additional TikTok creators that you want to invite to the campaign with a campaign-level invite link.
The new creators will be added to the existing list.

Max size: 100 per request. However, you can incrementally add up to 20,000 creators to a single campaign. For example, you can invite 100 handles in your first API call and another 100 in your second call.

For example, if you created a campaign with `handle_names` as `["{{handle_name_1}}","{{handle_name_2}}"]` and want to invite two more creators, you can pass `campaign_id` and set `handle_names` to `["{{handle_name_3}}","{{handle_name_4}}"]`. The `handle_names` value of the updated campaign will be `["{{handle_name_1}}","{{handle_name_2}}","{{handle_name_3}}","{{handle_name_4}}"]`. | |send_notification|boolean|Valid only for a campaign with a campaign-level invite link.
  • To retrieve such a campaign, use [/tto/tcm/campaign/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1815693562720258) and select one campaign with `campaign_type` as `CAMPAIGN`.

Whether to send a notification regarding the TTO Creator Marketplace campaign invitation to the inboxes of invited TikTok creators (`handle_names`).
The creators can open the notification to join the campaign.

Supported values: `true`,`false`.
Default value: `false`. | | advertiser_ids | string[] | A list of additional ad accounts to associate the campaign with.
When a creator's video is linked to the campaign, these ad accounts will automatically be granted Spark Ads authorization for the video.
You can specify ad accounts that share the same business center, legal entity, or logged in email.

Max size: 50.

For example, if you created a campaign with `advertiser_ids` as `["{{advertiser_id_1}}","{{advertiser_id_2}}"]` and want to invite two more creators, you can set `advertiser_ids` to `["{{advertiser_id_3}}","{{advertiser_id_4}}"]`. The `advertiser_ids` value of the updated campaign will be `["{{advertiser_id_1}}","{{advertiser_id_2}}","{{advertiser_id_3}}","{{advertiser_id_4}}"]`. | ``` ### Example #### Update a campaign with a campaign-level invite link ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tto/tcm/campaign/update/' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data '{ "tto_tcm_account_id": "{{tto_tcm_account_id}}", "campaign_id":"{{campaign_id}}", "campaign_type":"CAMPAIGN", "handle_names": ["{{handle_name}}"] }' (/code) ``` #### Update a campaign with a brand-level invite link ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tto/tcm/campaign/update/' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data '{ "tto_tcm_account_id": "{{tto_tcm_account_id}}", "campaign_id":"{{campaign_id}}", "campaign_type":"CAMPAIGN", "advertiser_ids": [ "{{advertiser_id}}" ] }' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{35%}|Type{10%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data |object|Returned data.| #| campaign_id | string | The ID of the TTO Creator Marketplace campaign. | #| brand_name | string | Brand name. | #| campaign_name | string | Campaign name. | #| handle_names | string[] | The handle name list of TikTok creators that the campaign is for. | #| campaign_description | string | Campaign description. | #|anchor_id|string|The ID of the anchor that is associated with the campaign.| #| advertiser_ids | string[] | A list of ad accounts that the campaign is associated with.
When a creator's video is linked to the campaign, these ad accounts will automatically be granted Spark Ads authorization for the video. | #| spark_ads_requested_authorization_days | integer | The default Spark Ads authorization days for videos uploaded to the campaign.

Enum values: 0, 7, 30, 60, 180, 365. | #| invite_link | string | The invite link that is associated with the TTO Creator Marketplace campaign.

The invite link will not expire. | #| create_time| string | The time when the campaign was created, in the format of `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`(UTC+0 time).

Example: `2024-01-01 00:00:01`. | #| campaign_type | string | The type of the TTO Creator Marketplace campaign.

Enum values:
  • `CAMPAIGN`: A campaign with a [campaign-level invite link](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1830337139853313#item-link-Campaign-level%20invite%20link).
  • `BRAND_LINK`: A campaign with a [brand-level invite link](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1830337139853313#item-link-Brand-level%20invite%20link).
| #| brand_profile_id | string | The ID of the Brand Profile associated with the campaign. | #|country_codes|string[]|Returned when at least one creator specified in the request parameter `handle_names` has been successfully invited to the campaign.

The list of countries or region codes associated with the campaign.
Example: `["US"]`.| #|failed_handle_names|string[]|Returned when at least one creator specified in the request parameter `handle_names` failed to be invited to the campaign.

The list of handles that failed to be added to the campaign.

For example, if you provided `["handle_name_1","handle_name_2"]` in the request parameter `handle_names` and `handle_name_1` was successfully added while `handle_name_2` failed, the response will show `handle_names` as `["handle_name_1"]` and `failed_handle_names` as `["handle_name_2"]`.| ``` ### Example #### Update a campaign with a campaign-level invite link ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "brand_name": "{{brand_name}}", "campaign_description": "{{campaign_description}}", "campaign_id": "{{campaign_id}}", "campaign_name": "{{campaign_name}}", "campaign_type": "CAMPAIGN", "create_time": "{{create_time}}", "handle_names": [ "{{handle_names}}", "{{handle_names}}" ], "invite_link": "{{invite_link}}", "spark_ads_requested_authorization_days": 0, "update_time": "{{update_time}}" } } (/code) ``` #### Update a campaign with a brand-level invite link ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "advertiser_ids": [ "{{advertiser_ids}}", "{{advertiser_ids}}" ], "brand_name": "{{brand_name}}", "brand_profile_id": "{{brand_profile_id}}", "campaign_id": "{{campaign_id}}", "campaign_type": "BRAND_LINK", "create_time": "{{create_time}}", "invite_link": "{{invite_link}}", "spark_ads_requested_authorization_days": 7, "update_time": "{{update_time}}" } } (/code) ```
